stills.name: proto3d-sail
stills.caption: SAIL: the hero glides over the first gap; the bar at the bottom is the glide left, the clock runs at the top right.

clips.name: proto3d-island-run
clips.caption: ISLAND: the hero runs and jumps across the island and onto a floating islet, taking three of the six pickups; the camera follows.

clips.name: proto3d-sail-glides
clips.caption: SAIL: the hero runs off the edge and glides over a gap to a small island, then glides over a second gap to the pad by the steps; the bar at the bottom shows the glide left.

clips.name: proto3d-stone-climb
clips.caption: STONE: standing on the slate slab, the hero raises it up the face of the cliff, then jumps off onto the top of the cliff below the GOAL.

clips.name: proto3d-machines
clips.caption: MACHINES: the hero picks up the bob and carries it onto the plate; the plate opens the way, a bridge rises, and the hero crosses it still carrying the bob.

stills.name: rooftop-dash
stills.caption: Room 4, DASH: the courier dashes across a gap and leaves a trail behind.

clips.name: rooftop-wall-jumps
clips.caption: Room 2, BROKEN GLASS: the courier jumps across a roof with glass under the ledges. Room 3, CHIMNEY: it jumps from wall to wall up a narrow shaft to the door.

clips.name: rooftop-rooms
clips.caption: Rooms 4 (DASH) and 5 (UPDRAFT) played through: the courier runs, jumps, dashes and rides an updraft between roofs to each room's door.

clips.name: rooftop-long-roof
clips.caption: Room 7, LONG ROOF: the view scrolls with the courier as it runs, jumps and dashes across a roof wider than the screen to the door.

clips.name: rooftop-delivery
clips.caption: Room 8, LAST ROOF: the courier jumps and dashes up to the door, then DELIVERED shows the total time and the time for each room.

stills.name: stardust-catch
stills.caption: A star caught in the lower right corner, marked by a flash box; 17 stars caught.

clips.name: stardust-first-stars
clips.caption: STARDUST opens at STARS 0, and the comet flies to the finger to catch its first six stars.

clips.name: stardust-catches
clips.caption: The comet follows a touch from star to star across the sky.

stills.name: skimmer-2v2
stills.caption: Two against two: coral mallets 1 and 3 and teal mallets 2 and 4, with the puck near teal mallet 2.

clip.name: skimmer-goal-run
clip.caption: Coral serves, the puck goes back and forth between four mallets, and teal scores.

clips.name: skimmer-wild-table
clips.caption: One against one on the WILD table, the computer on both sides: the puck bounces off the bumpers on the centre line, and TEAL scores.

stills.name: tundra-play
stills.caption: A BLUE skater carries the puck over centre ice toward AMBER player 1 and an AMBER computer skater.

clips.name: tundra-face-off
clips.caption: The opening face-off: AMBER player 1 takes the puck and pushes it to the BLUE net with two BLUE skaters on it. The BLUE goalie holds the puck and passes it out, and a BLUE skater carries it back toward centre ice.

clips.name: tundra-goal-run
clips.caption: A BLUE skater carries the puck over centre ice to the AMBER net, BLUE scores after a scramble in front of it (0 to 1), and the players line up for the next face-off.
